claim_ceiling: Source discovery only: no external data snapshot is imported, rights-cleared, or qualified for a Symtropy benchmark.

sources.title: A South African Power Supply Reliability Dataset, Structured for Count Time Series and Machine Learning Applications
limitations: paper reports 43,824 hourly observations from 2018-07-01 through 2023-06-30; exact downloadable byte artifact not yet independently located and hashed
variables describe national system supply-demand conditions and reliability; not a building or site-meter trace
publication licensing does not automatically clear the rights of underlying Eskom source data
not sufficient alone to assert battery dispatch feasibility, feeder power flow, or site-level service outcomes

sources.title: CityLearn official v3.0.2 public benchmark registry
sources.geography: varies by selected dataset; selected geography not yet pinned
sources.window_semantics: dataset_dependent; select only after registry and file checksum audit
limitations: official v3.0.2 release notes report 32 public datasets and removal of five rec_2023_* datasets, EC_Ermesinde and ALADI datasets
must select an actual dataset present in the exact official tag and pin every source file before scoring
simulator results are not field outcomes
verify the selected dataset license separately from CityLearn software license
electrical service constraint coverage depends on selected schema and does not automatically imply complete AC power-flow qualification

sources.title: Eskom Data Portal demand-side dashboard and system hourly actual/forecast demand
limitations: dashboard describes actual and forecast hourly demand for a recent rolling week
rolling export is mutable and is not a canonical benchmark until exact raw bytes and retrieval time are preserved
source values are utility-level data and must not be relabelled as local site demand
